verification.globalArchiveNote: Refresh reported six unrelated missing PS3 Discord paths. All 28 files in this Switch scope are present, independently rehashed and indexed. No unrelated files were changed.

notes: Pinned existing console builds were reused only after local/backup SHA-256 and NRO or ZIP inspection. Existing originals and old versions were kept.
NXMP and PPSSPP remain complete runtime ZIPs. ftpd offers standard NRO plus ZIP containing standard/classic variants.

PPSSPP retains explicit current-OS incompatibility warning before the download; no guessed numeric firmware range. Its store snapshot label is distinct from the official legacy page’s later 1.17.1+ label.
melonDS 7.2.1 publisher label is FW 21.x.x / AMS 1.10.0; no universal support for newer firmware is asserted. Required DS system dumps are documented but not supplied.
pNES / pSNES 7.x use optional gamelist.xml in ROM folders; old db.xml store instructions are not reused.
Moonlight documents full-RAM title redirection and a separate compatible PC host, without downloading every desktop variant.

Switch apps builder now inserts Setup & downloads links on the 11 selected cards and calls this scoped detail builder when preparation is complete. Existing app card IDs, direct downloads, versions, search/category behavior and older archive records remain.
After regenerating the apps library, run build-switch-resource-pages.cjs to retain previously added dedicated Atmosphere/Hekate/RetroArch hub routes.
Shared inventory lock contention was left intact. A cooperating writer incorporated all 11 scoped records; existence/version/hash were checked before the explicit final index refresh.
Sources were reviewed against official projects and the Switch App Store. Product icons retain original bytes, source URLs, sizes and SHA-256 values.

Continuation: seven remaining utilities and nine homebrew games now have individual image/setup/download pages. Every one of the 28 library cards links to its dedicated page, including the independently owned App Store.

Three absent store icons (ftpsrv, 90DNS tester, Cpp-Snake-NX) were recovered without modification from the verified NRO ASET sections. Source URL, member, size and SHA-256 recorded in docs/switch-app-embedded-image-sources.json. Other icons retain original PNG bytes.

Complete ftpsrv/OpenSupaplex/SuDokuL/pinballnx ZIPs preserve required configuration and runtime resources. Historical build versions and compatibility limits remain unchanged. 90DNS store 1.0.4 is explicitly distinguished from upstream 1.1.0.
Latest desktop and 390px phone checks cover all 27 generated pages; hero images load, buttons are at least 48px high, no horizontal overflow. Setup modal and library search/link flow verified.
